reason: DASH is primarily a terminal-native TUI frontend for a DeepSeek Harness agent, providing navigation, conversation, model switching, session controls, and visibility into tool activity.

summaries.zh: DASH 是 DeepSeek Harness 的终端原生全屏界面，用于交互式对话、模型切换、会话管理和查看工具活动。
summaries.en: DASH is a terminal-native full-screen interface for DeepSeek Harness that supports interactive conversations, model switching, session management, and tool-activity viewing.

capabilities: Provides a full-screen terminal-native interface for an agent harness
Switches between configured language models and providers
Stores and activates provider API credentials
Resumes, exports, and forks persisted agent sessions
Surfaces inherited agent tools and skill commands
